entry.title: New: Resolution 209 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO ASSIST THE HAWAIʻI POLICE DEPARTMENT WITH PURCHASING EQUIPMENT TO PROMOTE PUBLIC SAFETY

Transfers $23,998 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 5)
